description: This file defines a custom exception class `ScreenRenderException` used in the `org.apache.ofbiz.widget.renderer` package. It extends `GeneralException` and is used to wrap exceptions encountered during screen rendering processes in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ScreenRenderException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to indicate errors encountered during screen rendering in the OFBiz framework. It wraps general exceptions and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: ScreenRenderException()
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes a new instance of the exception without a message or cause.

methods.name: ScreenRenderException(Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a nested throwable cause.

methods.name: ScreenRenderException(String str)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a specific message.

methods.name: ScreenRenderException(String str, Throwable nested)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance with a message and a nested throwable cause.
